translations.web: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
translations.bsb: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.
translations.kjv: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
translations.asv: Thou also shalt be drunken; thou shalt be hid; thou also shalt seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
